skill.name: company-careers-jobs
skill.description: Get the open jobs of specific companies straight from the employer's own applicant tracking system (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio), looked up by company name, domain or careers-page URL, in one uniform schema, with a monitor mode that returns only newly posted jobs. Routes to jordan-belfort/ats-jobs-api and jordan-belfort/workday-jobs-scraper (1,447 Workday companies by name). Use when someone asks what NVIDIA, Stripe or Notion is hiring for, open roles at a list of companies, new postings since yesterday, hiring signals for sales or recruiting, a Workday, Greenhouse, Lever or Personio jobs API, or to track a company's careers page. Not for market-wide job search on LinkedIn or Indeed. $0.001 per job returned.
skill.summary: Retrieve and monitor company job postings across eight applicant tracking systems through paid Apify Actors.
skill.author: Jordan Belfort

The skill invokes paid third-party Apify Actors; their implementations and hosted services were not included in this review.

content.user_title: Find and Monitor Company Careers Jobs
content.value_statement: Company job postings are spread across different applicant tracking systems. This skill guides Apify lookups and monitoring across eight systems with consistent output fields.
actual_capabilities: Route company names, domains, and careers URLs to a multi-ATS Actor or a dedicated Workday Actor.
Configure title, location, remote-work, posting-age, and per-company result filters.
Retrieve consistent job fields, including employer, role, location, application URL, and available salary information.
Configure new-job monitoring with separate watch-list names and Apify schedules.
Guide Actor calls, input-schema retrieval, and dataset retrieval through Apify CLI or MCP.
Explain missing-company errors, ambiguous employer matches, billing estimates, and Workday result limits.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, authentication, network access, and paid third-party Actors; documented pricing is $0.001 per returned job.
Needs named companies, domains, or careers URLs; it does not provide market-wide LinkedIn or Indeed searches.
Supports eight documented ATS platforms; iCIMS, Taleo, SuccessFactors, and other unlisted systems are outside scope.
Workday results stop at 2,000 postings per site; dates and salary fields depend on source availability.

use_cases.title: Research target employers
use_cases.description: Find engineering openings at selected companies using location and remote-work filters.

use_cases.title: Monitor recruiting demand
use_cases.description: Configure separate company watch lists and recurring runs that return newly observed postings after the initial baseline.

use_cases.title: Track account hiring signals
use_cases.description: Collect relevant roles across a named account list and review employer matches, result counts, and dataset links.

prompt_templates.title: Find roles at one employer
prompt_templates.prompt: Find NVIDIA engineering roles in Germany. Limit results to 50, estimate the cost, and identify any lookup errors.

prompt_templates.title: Compare several employers
prompt_templates.prompt: Find remote engineering roles at Stripe, Notion, and Spotify. Cap each company at 25 results and verify employer matches.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: filtered searches across multiple companies

prompt_templates.title: Configure a recurring watch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a daily watch for Stripe and Notion using monitorName recruiting-watch. Cap each company at 50 jobs and explain baseline billing before scheduling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: stateful monitoring with a recurring schedule

prompt_templates.title: Plan a controlled batch
prompt_templates.prompt: For [company list], plan ATS routing and sales-role filters for the last 14 days. Cap each company at 20 results.

output_examples.input: Plan a first NVIDIA engineering search in Germany with a 50-job cap.
output: Illustrative plan: query NVIDIA with engineering and Germany filters, using the multi-ATS Actor.
Return at most 50 matching jobs. At the documented per-job rate, 50 returned jobs would cost approximately $0.05.
Verify the returned employer and provide the dataset link after execution.

output_examples.input: Explain a daily watch for Stripe and Notion.
output: Illustrative plan: use one named watch list with new-job monitoring enabled.
The first run returns current matching jobs. Later runs return only postings not previously observed by that monitor.
An Apify schedule can run the watch daily. A separate monitor name starts a separate history.

output_examples.input: A company name returned an error, while another company is absent.
output: An error row means no public board was found for that input. Retry with the exact careers URL.
A missing company without an error row can mean that no jobs passed the filters.
Check employer identity before accepting a name-based match.

best_practices: Use exact careers URLs when possible, and verify employer names and board identifiers in returned results.
Apply filters and a per-company cap before execution; estimate charges and confirm larger runs with the user.
Give each watch list a distinct monitor name and budget for the initial baseline before scheduling repeated runs.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for market-wide job searches without a target-company list.
Do not run broad company lists without result caps or assume the first monitoring run returns only future postings.
Do not assume missing salary fields, unknown posting dates, or filtered-out companies prove the source has no relevant jobs.

faq.question: Which applicant tracking systems are supported?
faq.answer: The documented platforms are Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, and Personio.

faq.question: What do I need before running a lookup?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account and authentication through CLI login or an API token. Execution uses Apify CLI or an MCP connection.

faq.question: How much does a lookup cost?
faq.answer: The documented Actor rate is $0.001 per returned job. Verify current pricing before execution and cap results to control charges.

faq.question: Does monitoring return only jobs posted after setup?
faq.answer: The first run returns current matching jobs because its history is empty. Later runs skip job identifiers already returned by that monitor.

faq.question: Can I search by company name alone?
faq.answer: Yes, but names can resolve incorrectly or fail discovery. Verify employer fields and use an exact careers URL when available.

faq.question: Are posting dates and salary details always available?
faq.answer: No. Fields depend on the employer's ATS data. Posting-age filters retain jobs without dates, except Workday jobs known to exceed 30 days.
